approach.method_basis: The Parent breeds fresh molecular graphs from its accepted population and uses a count-fingerprint Gaussian process to choose which offspring to evaluate. It fits a monotone output warp with a fixed unit linear term, then transforms correlated function draws back to score units. After three batches without a strict improvement, only the forty candidates with highest warped predictive expectation remain eligible. This complete model improved prediction loss on purchased molecules while its endpoint score declined.
approach.novelty: Change only the mean used to rank eligibility during those naturally stalled batches: use the original raw-score Gaussian-process mean already computed by the Parent. Keep the fitted warp, its genuine predictive expectation and every sampled function value. The test asks whether this small change in access to the existing pool produces different paid molecules and an endpoint gain on the complete unit-linear host. An earlier transfer on the more flexible warp showed real choice changes and a positive score, but incomplete fitted-law evidence; its benefit is not assumed here.

observed_bottleneck: The complete unit-linear code Parent n-2723e9d54276 accepts all 435 fits and supplies all 4350 prospective paid laws. Its primary same-paid pinball is 0.019241621706994037 versus original raw GP 0.019740935567642014, yet endpoint macro 0.5631604622840157 is -0.0090067557298343 versus its own code Parent n-80d9b7174bc7 and -0.04386985392711532 versus formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de. It contains 235 nonlinear and 200 exact-identity pools; 207 fits stop by ftol, with 21 projected gradients above 0.001 and five above 0.1, so its registered acceptance is not a stronger stationarity certificate. The inherited gate might restrict useful choices even when the fitted law lowers average purchased-stream loss. On the ten-parameter host, n-f45ac3b0bc90 changes 56 masks, 34 paid sets and 49 paid identities and gains +0.007594112734441327, but one essential unrestricted fit failure and ten missing laws leave its complete conditional prediction and contribution unresolved. Its finalized task_safe=true availability revision does not waive that missingness. Our saved-Search replay reproduces all 435 unit-Parent sequences and 4350 original paid identity joins; changing only the gate on the identical recorded warped rows changes 31 masks, 11 sets and 15 per-pool reference-only identities. The 352 unrestricted pools never differ, nine cells have no set exposure, and every seed-2 cell has zero replayed set exposure. This narrow opportunity predicts neither unpurchased rewards nor the Child adaptive result. hypothesis: Transfer only the registered eligibility consumer into the complete unit-linear Parent. For the unchanged accepted-score normalization m and s, t=(y-m)/s, C=K_XX+0.05^2 I+the original training jitter, and cross-covariance K_XP, use the already implemented alpha_raw=C^-1 t and mu_raw=m+s*(K_XP.T @ alpha_raw). When the original stall_streak>=3 supplies restrict_top_mean=40, eligible E is the first min(40,N) pool indices ordered by (-mu_raw[i],i); otherwise E contains the whole original pool. Retain the exact unit-linear g(t)=t+sum_{j=1}^3 a_j*tanh(b_j*(t+c_j)), its Jacobian-fitted nine coordinates, latent posterior, original normal array and warped sample rows v=m+s*g_inverse(mu_z+normal@pool_factor.T). Each batch position still takes the first index attaining its row maximum among currently eligible indices, then deletes that index. There is no translation, subtraction, rescaling, residual modification, new fit, changed covariance or different acquisition objective. The actual warped expectation/median/SD/quantiles remain unchanged predictions of this law; mu_raw is separately labeled as the eligibility coordinate. A passive old-warped-mean gate uses exactly these same v rows with separate availability. The intended path is changed naturally stalled access, changed accepted paid identities, changed later accepted archive/survivor/breeder use, and a conditional code-Parent endpoint effect. Later adaptive states can differ; equality assertions apply only to identical inputs. The original full-raw-GP comparator changes sample values as well as eligibility and is not the gate-only comparator.

finding_summary.headline: The raw-mean gate changes real purchases, but the complete endpoint-gain prediction is refuted.
finding_summary.insights: The eligibility coordinate can change actual access while leaving the fitted law and original samples intact, but this narrow transfer did not recover endpoint progress on the complete unit-linear host. Twelve of the 14 newly accessed purchases entered a subsequent successful fit, and four were later used as breeding parents; only one directly improved the incumbent. Those observations show propagation without identifying why the total endpoint fell. The retained warped law still had lower same-paid pinball loss than the raw GP, 0.019276 versus 0.019803, while its 90% interval coverage was lower; neither diagnostic was a new success criterion for this gate test. The molecular audit found nine unchanged trajectories, persistent local ring-family concentration, both very small and oversized products, and no specified atom stereochemistry despite 2,009 potentially unassigned structures. A graph proposal method that controls ring topology and preserves stereochemical and functional-group context could address those observed coverage limits; this experiment supplies no evidence of its score benefit. The result refutes this conditional gain prediction only. It preserves the Parent’s predictive confirmation, the donor’s unresolved missing-law result, and open questions about other hosts, retained components and causal mediation.
finding_summary.results: All 435 scheduled fits and all 4,350 original paid predictive laws are complete. Independent replay found 31 changed eligibility masks, ten changed purchase sets and 14 accepted molecules absent from the old gate’s choices. All 352 unrestricted pools kept exactly the same choices. Nine of fifteen sessions had no new paid-choice exposure, including every seed-2 session. With correct execution and real exposure established, the endpoint macro was 0.562332 versus 0.563160 for the code Parent: a decrease of 0.000828, below the registered gain of at least 0.002. Two task/seed endpoints improved, two declined and eleven tied; the two changing seed macros declined. The protocol task-safety comparison passed against the code Parent. Against the separate formal Anchor, the macro was lower by 0.044698 and the sitagliptin task-safety test failed. The formal goal’s distinct code-Parent condition remains unmet.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich chemistry remains close to Parent, with local N-N/thione shifts, unusual bond edits, size tails and unspecified stereochemistry.
molecular.overall_character: This assessment covers n-ef26feaa2bbb against code Parent n-2723e9d54276 under the exact frozen request. Child evaluation completeness and Parent pairing are separate checks: the request reports child_complete=true and paired_complete=true, and all 15 Child and 15 published Parent Search trajectory files and all six original summaries are present. Every cell contains 300 accepted records: ten initials plus 290 optimizer observations. Thus 4,350 optimizer records and 150 initials per node were read; all 9,000 structures parse with RDKit 2023.09.6 and every supplied digest example matches its exact source row. There are no missing tasks, seeds or pairings. Accepted chemistry is predominantly aromatic and ring-bearing: 4,268/4,350 Child records have rings and 4,246 have aromatic atoms, versus Parent 4,266 and 4,244. The digest ring-closure text rates span 0.9644-0.9954 and aromatic-presence text rates 0.9540-0.9908; these are molecule-level string indicators, not aromatic atom fractions or perceived ring counts. Aryl amides, fused aza-aromatics, cyclic carbonyls, saturated amine rings and fluorinated heterocycles are established output capabilities. Ordinary medicinal-chemistry groups coexist with covalent N-halogen, N-N, N-O, peroxide and unusually connected rings. There are 984 versus 960 N-halogen-containing records, 470 versus 350 N-N single-bond records, 370 versus 456 N-O single-bond records, and 126 versus 70 thione records. These connectivity counts are chemical-review flags, not measured instability rates, invalidity rates or proof of synthesis failure. No optimizer record has nonzero net formal charge or a specified atom chiral tag; 2,009 Child versus 2,066 Parent records have potential unassigned chiral centres. Neutral notation does not exclude protonatable amines or determine solution charge. Both size tails persist: Child versus Parent counts at most five heavy atoms are 79 versus 81; above 40/50/60 are 236/93/27 versus 240/94/27, with maximum 88 in each. In the exact late optimizer ordinals 146-290, each node contributes 2,175 records: small-fragment counts are 32 versus 34, above-50 counts 10 versus 11, and N-halogen counts 698 versus 673. These diagnostic bins are not proposed admission limits. Nine of fifteen ordered optimizer identity sequences equal Parent; the other six differ. Eleven endpoint ties include two cells with changed molecules, so endpoint equality is not general trajectory identity. This adaptive trajectory comparison is not a same-draw gate-exposure audit or proof of unique mediation. The frozen comparison records macro 0.562332033568631 versus 0.5631604622840157, signed delta -0.0008284287153846881; no activation, contribution, task-safety, ranking or selection verdict is made here. Pooled scaffold coverage remains moderate, with local series concentration rather than universal collapse. All descriptor, bond and scaffold measurements use sanitized RDKit structures, separately from digest text counters. The published Parent convention excludes empty typed/generic Murcko scaffolds and computes within-task all-pairs binary radius-2, 2048-bit chiral Morgan Tanimoto after excluding molecules below ten heavy atoms. The donor n-f45ac3b0bc90 convention includes the empty scaffold category and measures each optimizer molecule's maximum binary Morgan similarity to its own cell initials, excluding at most five heavy atoms from both sets, with default chirality disabled. Both are reported separately for this Child/Parent panel; they answer different questions and are not pooled. The current Parent's prior size, ring, bond, nonempty scaffold and all-pairs similarity summaries reproduce exactly under its original convention. The donor report is used only to preserve its measurement definition and source conditions, not to infer transferred efficacy. High/low groups use existing scores with deterministic seed/evaluation tie handling. They are descriptive subsets; tied scores cannot identify rewarded edits. Source identities, exact original paths, byte-preserved Child copies, method versions, all source hashes and limitations: policy/scratch/r0069-01-improve-L01/molecular-assess-v1/source-audit.frozen.json. Pooled evidence: policy/scratch/r0069-01-improve-L01/molecular-assess-v1/chemistry-summary.json. Each per-task entry cites its three audits and all six underlying trajectories. The audits also preserve initials, full optimizer observations, phases 1-97/98-193/194-290, and exact late ordinals 146-290. No unpurchased molecule is assigned a score; no synthesis route, stability outcome, pKa, docking pose or biological benefit is inferred.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
